pages.speaker: npc
lines: Welcome. Here, you may challenge the mansion's pride--the five Trainer maids. The challenge is to beat all five of us in a row without a break. In addition to beating us, if you can beat us in a specific number of turns, there will be a special gift. Incidentally, a turn refers to the time it takes for a Trainer and the opponent to each make an action. In this case, action refers to making a Pokémon use a move, using an item, or switching a Pokémon. And now...
